title: What's New in 1.1.4
content: Improvements Combined PDF progress: the progress window now counts the combined PDF as its own step. With three sheets it shows four steps and reads “Exporting combined file (PDF)…” while the merge runs. Easier tick boxes: in the sheet list you can now click the background around a checkbox to select the row and tick it, so you no longer have to hit the small square. Drag to tick several rows: press in the checkbox column and drag down to highlight several rows. When you release, they all take the same tick state as the first row. Clicks in the other columns still just select. Help link: “How do I Export Sheets?” now opens the Expert Sheets section of the tools page, the same page as the ? button.
